snippet.title: Phonopolis | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
📣 Phonopolis launches MAY 20, 2026 📣

Wishlist on Steam (Windows, macOS) and play the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206070/Phonopolis/

Also coming to GOG and Epic Games Store.

Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

Music by Tomáš Dvořák aka @Floex.
Narrated by Joe Acheson aka @hiddenorchestra.

Follow Amanita Design:
Website: https://amanita-design.net/
